title: Automotive braking system DFMEA
goal: Show a risk-ranked DFMEA for vehicle hydraulic braking functions.

rubric.must: A visible FMEA worksheet identifies Hydraulic braking system and its function.
Each visible risk row presents severity, occurrence, detection, and RPN values.
The worksheet visibly includes reduced pressure, uneven force, and lost assist modes.
Each cause row visibly associates prevention and detection controls with the risk.
Higher-risk rows are visibly flagged or ranked distinctly from lower-risk rows.
Narrow numeric score columns remain visually distinct from descriptive failure-analysis columns.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all six rules, while the picture omits required failure modes and separate prevention controls.
